sentences.text:
Author: Rajiv Gupta
Bench: Rajiv Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 1
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 6364 of 2023
Applicant :- Jaihind And 3 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Shiv Babu Dubey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to quash the summoning order dated 25.5.2022 passed by Additional District & Session/Special Judge (POCSO )Act, Lalitpur as well as entire proceedings of criminal Misc. Case No. 08 of 2019 a alongwith S.S.T.
No. 217/2022, under section 363, 366, 376(D) I.P.C. & 5/6 POCSO Act P.S. Jakhaura, District Lalitpur.

Learned counsel for the applicants has made a statement at the bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press other prayers made in the application and states that the applicants are ready to surrender before the court below and seek their bail and that their bail application be considered and disposed of in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Jaihind And 3 Others vs State Of U.P.And Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24728632/
1 Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Jaihind And 3 Others vs State Of U.P.And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. has submitted that he has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for applicants for not pressing the other prayers made in the application.

In view of the above, in case the applicants appear/surrender before the court below within three weeks from today and apply for bail, their bail application be considered and disposed of in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid observations, this application filed u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 R  Jaihind And 3 Others vs State Of U.P.And Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24728632/
